headline: Zuckerberg says Meta’s enterprise AI opportunity extends beyond agents
context: On the company’s second-quarter earnings call Wednesday, CEO Mark Zuckerberg said Meta sees a “large enterprise opportunity” spanning AI agents, APIs, compute, and internal software.
